23	/**
24	 * Counts how many existing owners share a candidate owner's first and last name,
25	 * comparing both names case-insensitively.
26	 */
27	@Component
28	public class NamesakeCounter {
29	
30	    /**
31	     * Count the owners in {@code existingOwners} whose first and last name match the
32	     * candidate's, ignoring case.
33	     *
34	     * @param candidate      the owner being created
35	     * @param existingOwners the owners to compare against (the candidate itself must not be included)
36	     * @return the number of matching namesakes
37	     */
38	    public int count(Owner candidate, Collection<Owner> existingOwners) {
39	        String firstName = candidate.getFirstName();
40	        String lastName = candidate.getLastName();
41	        return (int) existingOwners.stream()
42	            .filter(existing -> firstName.equalsIgnoreCase(existing.getFirstName())
43	                && lastName.equalsIgnoreCase(existing.getLastName()))
44	            .count();
45	    }
46	}
